relation_vocabulary.label: includes capability
relation_vocabulary.plain_language: A product includes a product capability.
relation_vocabulary.forbidden_collapse: Does not prove implementation.

relation_vocabulary.label: requests resolution from
relation_vocabulary.plain_language: A bounded request asks one capability to resolve context.
relation_vocabulary.forbidden_collapse: Does not grant authority.

relation_vocabulary.label: produces
relation_vocabulary.plain_language: A capability or component produces an output or record.
relation_vocabulary.forbidden_collapse: Does not accept the output.

relation_vocabulary.label: requires
relation_vocabulary.plain_language: A business behavior depends on a rule remaining true.
relation_vocabulary.forbidden_collapse: Does not make the rule canonical.

relation_vocabulary.label: specializes
relation_vocabulary.plain_language: A narrower capability applies the shared meaning to one domain.
relation_vocabulary.forbidden_collapse: Does not transfer ownership or make the specialization identical to its parent.

relation_vocabulary.label: contains context for
relation_vocabulary.plain_language: A bounded view includes a selected record relevant to its request.
relation_vocabulary.forbidden_collapse: Does not copy source authority into the view.

relation_vocabulary.label: realizes part of
relation_vocabulary.plain_language: A Project is connected to the thesis portion it seeks to realize.
relation_vocabulary.forbidden_collapse: Does not prove realization.

relation_vocabulary.label: belongs to
relation_vocabulary.plain_language: A Goal belongs to one Project.
relation_vocabulary.forbidden_collapse: Does not activate either lifecycle.

relation_vocabulary.label: advances
relation_vocabulary.plain_language: A Goal seeks progress toward a thesis connection.
relation_vocabulary.forbidden_collapse: Does not achieve the Goal or prove the thesis.

relation_vocabulary.label: consumed by
relation_vocabulary.plain_language: A product output is intended as input to another capability.
relation_vocabulary.forbidden_collapse: Does not prove actual or correct consumption.

relation_vocabulary.label: supplies
relation_vocabulary.plain_language: A Registry supplies selected records to resolution.
relation_vocabulary.forbidden_collapse: Membership does not create a binding.

relation_vocabulary.label: included in
relation_vocabulary.plain_language: A candidate concept is represented within a bounded view.
relation_vocabulary.forbidden_collapse: Does not resolve or promote that concept.

relation_vocabulary.label: accepts
relation_vocabulary.plain_language: A component accepts a closed request record.
relation_vocabulary.forbidden_collapse: Does not establish a deployed API.

relation_vocabulary.label: uses adapter
relation_vocabulary.plain_language: A resolver delegates registry-specific reading to an adapter.
relation_vocabulary.forbidden_collapse: Does not transfer registry ownership.

relation_vocabulary.label: reads from
relation_vocabulary.plain_language: An adapter reads one declared Registry.
relation_vocabulary.forbidden_collapse: Does not authorize writes.

relation_vocabulary.label: reads snapshot
relation_vocabulary.plain_language: A resolver reads one exact selection snapshot.
relation_vocabulary.forbidden_collapse: Does not treat a snapshot as authority.

relation_vocabulary.label: emits
relation_vocabulary.plain_language: A component emits a no-effect run record.
relation_vocabulary.forbidden_collapse: Does not create a decision or lifecycle transition.

relation_vocabulary.label: appended to
relation_vocabulary.plain_language: A run record may be appended to a run ledger.
relation_vocabulary.forbidden_collapse: The ledger is not current context truth.

relation_vocabulary.label: proposed realization of
relation_vocabulary.plain_language: A system component is a candidate realization of business meaning.
relation_vocabulary.forbidden_collapse: Does not establish implementation or conformance.

relation_vocabulary.label: traced to
relation_vocabulary.plain_language: A system record retains its business meaning reference.
relation_vocabulary.forbidden_collapse: Does not let system shape redefine business meaning.

relation_vocabulary.label: projects candidate of
relation_vocabulary.plain_language: A system projection represents a business concept as a candidate record.
relation_vocabulary.forbidden_collapse: Does not accept or promote the projection.

relation_vocabulary.label: constrained by
relation_vocabulary.plain_language: A system component must preserve a business rule.
relation_vocabulary.forbidden_collapse: Does not prove enforcement.
